entities.description: A man embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: Author of the Necromancer's Handbook.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who protected his body well but neglected his soul.

entities.description: A figure urging belief in the ideal.

entities.description: A warrior kingdom.

events.summary: Najib retreats to his castle at El-Abar and dwarven forces raze its walls in one night; he is dead by morning.
events.quote: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead.

events.summary: Verick holds his breath to hide from goblins.
Crovax orders enemies killed and fed to new recruits.
events.quote: Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits.

events.summary: Numsgil becomes goblin king by killing Blog, who had killed his predecessors in turn.
events.quote: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok.

events.summary: General Khurzog scolds the spies for mingling with orcish regulars.
events.quote: Never let the spies mingle with the orcish regulars after completing a mission.

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter warns Hans of the lhurgoyf in her last words.
events.quote: Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!

events.summary: Eladamri expresses a hope to walk where there was water.
events.quote: One day we shall walk where once was water.
